title: Same-currency check binds as a ?? (null === b), so every transaction gets its own amount as the native amount

bugs.note: === binds tighter than ??, so the condition is the native currency id itself, which is truthy whenever a native currency is set. The converted native amount of a foreign-currency transaction is replaced by its amount in the original currency, so 100 USD shows and sums as 100 EUR.
